transformation_summary: Converted adjusted prices to daily log-returns; calculated 20-day cross-sectional momentum z-scores and annualized rolling volatility; added next-day returns in excess of the same-day cross-sectional mean; removed incomplete rows.

schema.date: Trading date associated with the contemporaneous features
schema.vol_20d: Annualized standard deviation of daily log-returns over 20 trading days
schema.fwd_1d_excess_ret: Next-day log-return minus the cross-sectional mean next-day log-return
